statements.status_notes: The advisory covers auth.Client bearer-realm handling in registry/remote/auth/client.go (Client.Do, Client.fetchBearerToken, fetchDistributionToken, fetchOAuth2Token), fixed in oras-go 2.6.1. That package tree does not exist in the v1 module line: oras.land/oras-go v1.2.5 ships only pkg/**, and the devfile-gem Go binary links pkg/oras, pkg/auth/docker, pkg/content, pkg/artifact and pkg/target. The vulnerable code is absent.
